name: PAX2 Headline Ranker
method: pairwise L2 logistic regression on the feature difference of winner and loser (order randomized), headlines pooled across image variants within each test, 1000+ impressions; split by test id 80/20; C chosen by 5-fold grouped CV on the training tests
score: p(beats a typical rival) = sigmoid(intercept + sum_j weight_j * (feature_j - mean_j)), means over the training headlines
